classification: sensitive to one or more evaluation assumptions

rule.rule: No new validation pass or modification to Trial2. Unsupported under conservative analysis only if both adequate disjoint-parent original-binary and source+recovery-clean disjoint-parent results have AUROC<=.5 or upper95%<=.5. Sensitive if an adequate subset drops>=.10 AUROC relative to pooled baseline, a stratum has contour-aspect advantage<=0 with stratum AUROC gap>=.10, uniform partial-recoding AUROC range>=.10 or either recoding drops>=.10, or repeat same/different retention<.80 or repeat-relabelled binary AUROC drops>=.10. Otherwise robust with important qualifications if any key subset is underpowered, partial retention<.80/exact agreement<.85, adjacent contrast AUROC<.65 or lower95%<=.5. Robust only if no listed sensitivity/qualification applies. These interpretive conventions describe robustness, not retrospective changes to frozen success criteria.
rule.underpowered: Do not call a sparse conservative subset failed merely because a meaningful interval cannot be estimated; report loss of support explicitly.
